北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 -9℃！请您多穿衣，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like -9℃. Dress warm and stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有点凉，体感 3℃，记得添衣哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool, feels like 3℃. Remember to add a layer!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 4℃。外出别忘加件外套，小心感冒！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 4℃. Take a jacket when out, stay healthy!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖暖的，体感 12℃。湿度大，心情也要棒棒哒！

广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光好，体感 13℃。好好享受这温暖的一天吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, feels like 13℃. Enjoy this lovely warm day!

杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 1℃。出行请注意交通安全，保暖防寒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, feels like 1℃. Drive carefully and keep warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感 -2℃！风力 2 级，别忘多穿点衣服哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cold, feels like -2℃. With 2-level wind, remember to layer up!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 6℃。湿度 84%，记得保持心情舒畅！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 6℃. 84% humidity, keep a cheerful mood!

武汉.name: 武汉

西安.name: 西安

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -31℃！冰天雪地，务必全副武装防寒！

沈阳.name: 沈阳
